"No one looks like they're working. Seems so disorganized. There's no structure. Can't really tell what's going on. It doesn't look like one person is accountable. It's just confusing & doesn't match what I'm used to"

Exec upon interacting with a really skilled, empowered team.

Healthy teams tweak/adapt the way they work. Constantly.

Less experienced  teams believe they just need to figure out the magic workflow & stick to it.

So any tool that discourages adaptation (note this is not just "customization", this is continuous adaptation) is a liability

Awesome crowd-sourced thread. Great product managers ... from the perspective of developers and designers. #prodmgmt #ux #design #developer
